about: memory.mts --warmup --budgets: three practice matches on SwiftShader, each entered and left in its warm-up, title modules only. 'leak' is what grew from the second left sample to the third (never negative); 'left3' is what the renderer holds that no resource scope owns (__kr.resAudit, ?resaudit). These are ceilings: underPct 100 turns off the more-than-under failure, because growth between matches is zero when nothing leaks. Set 2026-11-05 with every PR of this batch merged in order, from two runs on 4 vCPUs: leak 0.5 MB WebGL, 0 textures, up to 5 geometries; left3 1381-1386 unowned resources, 1576-1577 MB.
